verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator documents a choice between keeping codes on the device ('Use without an account') and syncing them to a Google Account, but nothing lets the user pick a storage region or residency for synced data. The local-versus-cloud choice is an adjacent control, not region or residency selection, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
